textTemplates.description: Text email to the account owner when a new request is submitted.
textTemplates.name: txt_AccountOwnerEmail
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!Get_Hardware_Request.Created_By_Contact_Account__r.Owner.FirstName},
{!Get_Hardware_Request.Created_By_Contact__r.FirstName} {!Get_Hardware_Request.Created_By_Contact__r.LastName} has submitted a hardware delivery questionnaire. Please review for completeness and accuracy. Note, that the details on the questionnaire (ship-to location, quantity, type, etc.) will need to match the details on the PO. Any discrepancies may cause delays in order processing and delivery. If the questionnaire is correctly completed, please assign it to the appropriate opportunity. If it is incorrect or incomplete, please have the customer submit a new request.
Record link: {!$Setup.Automation_Management__c.SFDC_Server__c}{!Get_Hardware_Request.Id}
For questions, please contact hardware@tanium.com.
Thank you,
Tanium Team
